context: A boss and his manager discuss morning crime headlines
purpose: Teach: 刑務所/徴収/独裁/妨害/騒動/偽装/偽造/言論

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝の新聞、見たか？大物政治家が文書偽造の容疑で逮捕されたらしいぞ。
lines.en: Did you see this morning's paper? A big-shot politician was apparently arrested on document forgery charges.
lines.style: Gruff senior boss voice, low and authoritative, slightly indignant morning tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、私も読みました。税金の徴収にも不正があったとか。とんでもない騒動になっていますね。
lines.en: Yes, I read it too. Apparently there was fraud in tax collection too. It's turned into quite an uproar.
lines.style: Polite mid-career manager, measured and respectful, slightly disgusted undertone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 有罪になれば刑務所行きだろうな。あれだけの地位にいて、よくもまあ恥ずかしくないもんだ。
lines.en: If he's found guilty, it'll be prison for him. With a position like his, you'd think he'd be ashamed.
lines.style: Boss venting frustration, gravelly and emphatic, jaded older man tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: しかも記者会見では、報道を妨害するような発言まであったそうですよ。
lines.en: And on top of that, at the press conference he apparently made remarks that almost obstructed the reporting.
lines.style: Formal subordinate adding detail, slightly leaning forward, careful considered delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ひどい話だ。言論の自由はどこへ行ったんだ。まるで独裁国家みたいなやり方じゃないか。
lines.en: Terrible story. Whatever happened to freedom of speech? It's like the way things are done in a dictatorship.
lines.style: Frustrated boss lamenting loudly, deep voice with a heavy sigh at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 派閥ぐるみで帳簿を偽装していた疑いもあるとか。根は深そうですね。
lines.en: There's also suspicion the whole faction was falsifying the books. The roots seem to run deep.
lines.style: Manager speculating cautiously, factual and slightly grim, steady professional pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: まったく、朝からろくな話がない。コーヒーでも飲んでから仕事に取りかかろう。
lines.en: Honestly, not a single decent story this morning. Let's grab some coffee before getting to work.
lines.style: Resigned boss shifting topics warmly, inviting tone and slightly weary delivery.
